components.name: seat_shell
components.description: Main upholstered seat structure, centered on the chair and symmetric about x=0. Use a broad rounded-rectangle plan approximately 700 mm wide and 610 mm deep, with the front at negative y. The shell should have a thick, softly convex perimeter and rounded front corners rather than a rectangular block. Its underside forms the structural base above the legs, while its upper surface transitions continuously into the cushion and side structures. Suitable construction is a union or local hull of scaled rounded solids, retaining enough thickness under each leg location for slot geometry.

components.name: seat_cushion
components.description: Thick gray upholstered cushion nested on top of the seat shell, approximately 650-680 mm wide, 520-560 mm deep, and 110-140 mm thick. Dominant outline is a rounded rectangle with a softly crowned perimeter. The sitting surface has a shallow centered depression, about 20-35 mm deep, formed with a smooth broad subtractor so it reads as compressed upholstery rather than a hard cavity. The front edge is convex and softly rolled; all transitions are smooth and free of sharp corners.

components.name: backrest
components.description: Tall ergonomic upholstered back rising from the rear of the seat to the overall 900 mm chair height. Front view is a broad rounded trapezoid or shield-like outline, wider near the lower shoulder region and gently narrowing toward the rounded top corners. Side profile curves rearward from the seat and then subtly returns forward near the upper back, producing lumbar and shoulder support. Use overlapping scaled spheres, sampled profiles, or short local hull segments to obtain smooth curvature without a flat slab appearance. The backrest is centered at x=0 and blends continuously into the seat shell and rear portions of both arms.

components.name: left_armrest
components.description: Short upholstered arm on the negative-x side, beginning at the backrest and extending forward only about half to two-thirds of the seat depth. It reaches the leftmost overall extent at x=-450 mm. The dominant outline is a low curved bolster with an oval or rounded-rectangular cross-section, a gently convex elbow surface, and a downward-curving front termination. It must blend into the backrest and seat shell without a visible gap.

components.name: right_armrest
components.description: Mirror of the left armrest on the positive-x side, reaching x=+450 mm. It is short relative to the seat depth, has an oval or rounded-rectangular cross-section, a gently convex elbow-rest surface, and a rounded front end that curves downward into the seat side. It blends continuously into the backrest and seat shell.

components.name: front_apron
components.description: Upholstered lower front band beneath the cushion, spanning most of the chair width at the negative-y side. Its visible face is slightly convex in plan and vertically rounded, approximately 120-170 mm tall. It provides a continuous mounting surface for the nailhead trim and visually conceals the under-seat structure. The apron should merge into the seat shell and side panels rather than appear as a detached rail.

components.name: underseat_mounting_deck
components.description: Hidden structural material integrated into the underside of the upholstered body. It is a broad, mostly horizontal deck above the legs with four locally thickened receiver regions around x=±330 mm and y approximately ±255 mm. Each receiver region must contain sufficient solid material around its slot and must remain concealed in the assembled view. Avoid cutting slots through the visible cushion, apron, or outer upholstery surfaces.

components.name: nailhead_trim
components.description: A symmetric row of approximately 13 evenly spaced decorative nailheads along the lower front apron, centered about x=0 near the bottom front edge. Each nailhead is a small metallic-gray or silver spherical cap, roughly 16-20 mm in visible diameter, partially embedded into the apron so it is connected rather than floating. The row follows the slight front curvature while remaining level in z, and stops well before the rounded side corners.

components.name: front_left_leg
components.description: Straight square wooden leg below the front-left portion of the chair at negative x and negative y. Nominal cross-section is about 70 x 70 mm with only small edge softening; the shaft remains vertical and untapered. It extends from a flat foot at z=0 to the underside mounting deck. A centered top tab is generated by the assembly connector and requires a solid shoulder around its embedded root.

components.name: front_right_leg
components.description: Straight square wooden leg mirroring the front-left leg at positive x and negative y. It has an approximately 70 x 70 mm constant square cross-section, vertical sides, a flat coplanar foot at z=0, and a solid upper shoulder supporting the generated connector tab.

components.name: rear_left_leg
components.description: Straight square wooden leg below the rear-left receiver at negative x and positive y. It uses the same wooden material, height, approximately 70 x 70 mm section, vertical orientation, and flat z=0 foot as the front legs. Its top contains sufficient material for a centered upward tab and embedded tab root.

components.name: rear_right_leg
components.description: Straight square wooden leg mirroring the rear-left leg at positive x and positive y. It has a constant square section, vertical shaft, flat foot at z=0, and a solid top shoulder around the generated upward tab.

relations: Use world coordinates with +x to the chair's right, +y toward the back/inward side, and +z upward. The chair front therefore faces -y.

The complete assembled chair must occupy exactly 900 mm in x, 800 mm in y, and 900 mm in z. The outer arm surfaces establish x=-450 mm and x=+450 mm, the foremost and rearmost upholstered surfaces establish the 800 mm depth, the four feet lie at z=0, and the rounded backrest top establishes z=900 mm.
The upholstered body is bilaterally symmetric about x=0. The right arm, right-side leg placement, seat contour, backrest contour, and nailhead spacing mirror the corresponding left-side features.

The seat cushion sits within and overlaps the seat shell so there are no open seams. Its depressed sitting region is centered slightly behind the cushion midpoint, while the perimeter remains visibly higher and softly crowned.
The backrest grows from the rear of the seat shell with continuous overlap. Its front support surface curves smoothly in side view and must not read as a vertical planar board.

Both armrests join the lower sides of the backrest and the seat shell. Their rounded front ends stop short of the front cushion edge so they read as short elbow rests rather than full-length side walls.

The front apron lies below the cushion at the front side and remains continuous with the seat shell. The nailhead caps overlap the apron surface slightly and form one centered, level, evenly pitched row.

Place the front leg centers near x=-330 mm and x=+330 mm at a common negative-y coordinate near y=-255 mm. Place the rear leg centers at the same x coordinates and a common positive-y coordinate near y=+255 mm. Final centers may be adjusted modestly to remain fully beneath the mounting deck while preserving symmetry and a broad stable footprint.
All four leg shafts are parallel to +z, have equal length, and terminate on one common z=0 support plane. No upholstered geometry or connector geometry may extend below the feet.

The chair_body print part keeps the seat, cushion, backrest, arms, apron, hidden mounting deck, and nailhead trim together to preserve the continuous upholstered appearance and avoid assembly seams across curved fabric surfaces. Its likely print orientation has a broad under-seat deck as the principal bed-facing reference, although authorized 24-way orientation evaluation may select a better independent-bed rotation.

Each wooden leg is initially a separate print part because its square foot supplies a simple bed face, the straight shaft avoids a large upholstered-body cantilever, and separate printing preserves a clean visual material boundary between wood and upholstery.

Each leg-to-body interface uses one vertical tab-slot connector. The tab belongs to the leg and points upward from the leg top into a slot in the underseat mounting deck. All four interfaces use the same TabSlot parameter set and the frozen single-sided fit allowance of 0.2 mm, but every interface has distinct endpoint port names.

Connection evaluation begins with chair_body as the placed root. Each slot frame on chair_body locates its corresponding unplaced leg through the matching leg tab frame. Connection order is an evaluation order and not a claim about practical physical assembly sequence.

The visible upholstery uses a uniform solid medium gray. The API-supported color should suggest smooth tweed or linen without making an explicit texture mandatory. Legs use a warm medium-to-dark wood-brown color, and nailheads use a contrasting metallic-looking light or medium gray achievable through color alone.
Build only the chair. The requested black background is presentation context and must not be represented by a floor, backdrop, pedestal, or additional print part.
critic_checklist: Verify the assembled bounds are exactly 900 x 800 x 900 mm with mm_per_unit=1.0.
Verify all four leg feet are flat, coplanar at z=0, and no other geometry extends below z=0.
Verify the chair is symmetric about x=0 except for no intentional asymmetry; mirrored arm, leg, and body features must have matching dimensions and offsets.
Verify the seat reads as a thick rounded cushion and includes a broad, shallow sitting depression rather than a deep bowl, through-hole, or hard-edged recess.
Verify the backrest has visible ergonomic curvature in side view, rounded upper corners, and a smooth continuous junction with the seat and arms.
Verify each armrest is short, curved, suitable for elbow support, and terminates behind the foremost cushion edge.
Verify the upholstered body has no accidental gaps between seat shell, cushion, backrest, armrests, and front apron.
Verify there are approximately 13 evenly spaced nailhead caps in one centered row along the lower front apron; each cap must intersect the apron slightly and must not float.
Verify the nailheads are visible from the front and do not continue around the sides or appear on the cushion.
Verify all four legs are straight, vertical, equal-length square wooden shafts with a stable wide footprint and no unintended taper or splay.
Verify the four leg connectors are generated only through FixedAssembly.connect using TabSlot parameters; do not manually model duplicate tabs or slot cutters.
Verify each leg has one unique tab port and chair_body has four unique slot ports, with no reused endpoint port name for the same role.
Verify the front-left, front-right, rear-left, and rear-right slots retain adequate mounting material and do not break through visible upholstery surfaces.
Verify assembled connector tabs and slots do not remain visibly exposed around the leg shoulders.
Verify chair_body is the root part and every ordered connection has chair_body already placed when its leg is located.
Verify the frozen fit_offset_mm remains 0.2 mm and is applied once as the TabSlot single-sided slot allowance.
Verify the upholstery is solid gray, the four legs are visually wooden through brown color, and the nailheads visibly contrast; do not require unsupported shader roughness or fabric texture controls.
Verify the scene contains no modeled floor, black backdrop, lighting rig, or unrelated presentation geometry.
Verify the final source defines the global assembly and finishes with scene = assembly.scene(), with no transforms or decorative additions applied to scene afterward.
Treat visual-only approval as appearance/export approval only; do not claim that connector clearance demonstrates retention, strength, or full manufacturing validation.

connections.insertion_direction: +z from the top of the front-left leg into the underside of chair_body
connections.fit_intent: Centered vertical slip-fit demonstration joint using the frozen 0.2 mm single-sided slot allowance; tab root overlaps the solid leg top and the slot is enclosed by the front-left mounting block.

connections.insertion_direction: +z from the top of the front-right leg into the underside of chair_body
connections.fit_intent: Mirror of the front-left vertical slip-fit demonstration joint, using the same TabSlot dimensions and frozen 0.2 mm single-sided allowance.

connections.insertion_direction: +z from the top of the rear-left leg into the underside of chair_body
connections.fit_intent: Centered vertical slip-fit demonstration joint using the shared leg-mount parameters, with adequate receiver material retained toward the rear of the mounting deck.

connections.insertion_direction: +z from the top of the rear-right leg into the underside of chair_body
connections.fit_intent: Mirror of the rear-left vertical slip-fit demonstration joint, sharing identical connector dimensions and the frozen 0.2 mm single-sided allowance.
